# Microsoft.PowerShell.PSResourceGet

## About

Microsoft.PowerShell.PSResourceGet module is the package manager for PowerShell.
See our [Official Documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/powershell/module/microsoft.powershell.psresourceget).

## Usage

Using `Install-PSResource`:

`$mcrUrl = 'https://mcr.microsoft.com'`
`Register-PSResourceRepository -Name MAR -Uri $mcrUrl -ApiVersion ContainerRegistry`
`Install-PSResource -Name microsoft.powershell.psresourceget -Prerelease -Reinstall -Repository MAR`

For more instructions please refer to this [documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/powershell/gallery/powershellget/supported-repositories?view=powershellget-3.x#microsoft-artifact-registry-mar).

## Support

If you have any problems with or questions about this module, please contact us through a [GitHub issue](https://github.com/PowerShell/PSResourceGet/issues).
